current_round.prompt:
From: Kevin Xiong <kevin.xiong@insurity.com>
Subject: Bug: evidence[0]: invalid type: map output-contract fault survives the 4.3.2 unknown-field fix

Body:
Version: 4.3.2 (commit 48804eebdcd830cb98fe8dabea39ced4c651a36a)
Node: bo2lnxipsapp01 �P Agent model: claude-opus-4-7[1m] (also reproduced earlier on 4-8)
Severity: High �X silently discards a completed agent turn. In our case the implement agent ran ~1 hour (23 e2e runs, real auth fixes, isolated the target bug) and all of it was lost at the reporting step over the JSON shape.

Symptom

Failed round, failure_category: workflow:
Skill output contract failed: Skill invocation
1a7d38c65afa176c2734d64e26c9d9b8fe0fcbb869746ae3226a2fe93310a392
required bindings [default-implement] cannot authorize a gate: Error;
agent returned invalid structured Skill completion report:
does not match the required schema at field `evidence[0]`: invalid type: map, expected a string
Goal: 00000T12G5WS2J4A7NGFJ8C00F, round 4.

Root cause

src/application/agent_io/contracts/skill_result.rs:
- SkillReport (line ~35) is #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] with pub evidence: Vec<String> (line 40).
- The a4e27372 normalization in decode_result sanitizes only the top-level key set:
object.retain(|key, _| matches!(key.as_str(),
    "invocation_id"|"binding_id"|"role"|"outcome"|"summary"|"evidence"|"artifacts"));
  This strips unknown top-level fields (e.g. checklist) �X which fixes the unknown field variant. But it does not touch the contents of retained fields.

When the model emits evidence as an array of objects (e.g. [{"id":"P1","detail":"..."}] instead of ["..."]), retain keeps the evidence key, then SkillReport deserialization fails on Vec<String> �� evidence[0]: invalid type: map, expected a string. The normalization never had a chance to catch it.

So a4e27372 fixed the unknown-field variant but not the wrong-element-type variant of the same class of fault.

Reproduction

Feed decode_result a completion whose evidence is an array of maps:
{"outcome":"success","summary":"...","evidence":[{"id":"P1","note":"did X"}],"artifacts":{}}
�� errors with evidence[0]: invalid type: map, expected a string. (The existing test at ~line 191 shows the intended shape: evidence as strings, structured data like checklist under artifacts �X models routinely don't follow this.)

Suggested fixes (any one)

1. Coerce/normalize evidence elements in the same decode_result boundary: for each non-string element, stringify it (serde_json::to_string) or lift objects into artifacts �X mirroring how unknown top-level keys are already tolerated there.
2. Loosen the field type: evidence: Vec<Value> (or a #[serde(deserialize_with=...)] that accepts string-or-object and renders to string), keeping the strict persisted SkillResult as-is downstream.
3. At minimum, route this through the structured-output repair loop instead of hard-failing, so a malformed envelope gets one corrective re-prompt rather than discarding a completed turn.

Impact note

Because this rejects at the reporting step after the work is done, a long, successful agent turn is thrown away �X very costly. Same class as the earlier 2 distinct JSON candidates / unknown field checklist faults; the model just picks a different wrong shape.

[cid:insurity-small2_60d9d841-975e-4326-81a1-42eb773307d1.jpg]

Kevin Xiong

Senior Developer

T 860-616-7842

## Implement

Implement the plan.

### Outcome

The plan is implemented in a way that aligns with the project's purpose and architecture. Provide a brief summary organized by plan task: what changed, any important departures from the plan and why, and any unfinished work.

### Guardrails

- Follow established code patterns and put shared behavior in one place. Fix the underlying cause rather than each symptom separately.
- Keep code focused on one responsibility and preserve stable interfaces where possible. Split mixed responsibilities into separate files. Keep files relatively small, under roughly 1,000 lines where possible.
- Prefer clear, straightforward code and abstractions that make the behavior easier to understand and maintain.

{{templates.purpose}}

{{templates.architecture}}

plan.details: In src/application/agent_io/contracts/skill_result.rs, extend decode_result’s normalization callback: when evidence is an array, preserve string entries unchanged and serialize every non-string entry as compact JSON text. Preserve order and all entries, including objects, arrays, numbers, booleans, and null. Keep missing evidence defaulting to an empty vector; reject non-array evidence as before. Document this compatibility behavior. Keep SkillReport and persisted SkillResult evidence typed as Vec<String>, with existing identity and outcome validation.
plan.task: Task #1 - Normalize evidence at the existing ingestion boundary

plan.details: Add the reported object-evidence reproduction and mixed-element cases. Verify serialized entries can be parsed back to their original JSON values, existing strings remain unchanged, and summary, artifacts, and success/failure/error outcomes are preserved. Cover host-bound and explicit legacy identities across the existing transport fixtures. Replace the current test that rejects evidence:[42] with acceptance coverage. Retain rejection tests for non-array evidence, invalid outcomes, malformed summaries, missing or mismatched identity, ambiguous candidates, and transport bounds. Add a direct persisted-SkillResult deserialization check showing that object evidence remains invalid outside ingestion.
plan.task: Task #2 - Cover normalization and strictness with decoder regressions

plan.details: Extend the existing event completion fixtures in src/application/events/tests/repairs.rs to return structured evidence. Verify a successful completion persists normalized evidence and satisfies the required gate without another provider call. Verify a failure verdict remains a failure. Exercise retained receipt decoding under existing checkout and authority checks, confirming that raw output remains intact. Use deterministic fixtures; no live provider session is needed.
plan.task: Task #3 - Verify completion acceptance through the application path

plan.details: Run the Skill result decoder, structured-output, and affected event completion tests using the repository’s explicit --lib/--bins test invocation, then run the unit suite, cargo fmt --all -- --check, and git diff --check. Record results and any blockers for Quality. This fix requires no schema migration, repair-policy change, or workflow-state mutation.
plan.task: Task #4 - Run focused checks and hand off validation

evidence: decode_result currently removes unknown top-level fields but leaves evidence elements unchanged before deserializing SkillResult.evidence as Vec<String>.
The shared decoder selects and bounds the JSON candidate before normalization, so the fix can preserve existing transport and ambiguity checks.
Event completion uses this decoder for fresh and retained responses. Its repair policy currently allows zero repairs; raw responses are persisted before decoding.
default-plan.summary: Accept structured evidence in otherwise valid Skill completions by converting non-string evidence entries to compact JSON strings at the provider ingestion boundary. Preserve the agent’s verdict, evidence content, and strict persisted SkillResult schema.
